segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and ticket number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northstar Fixtures. Ticket 48219. We need to add three seats to our account before Monday, if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have Northstar Fixtures up in the admin console. You’re currently on the Standard annual plan with 24 seats, renewal on November 30. You want to move to 27 seats, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. The new users are jlee, rpatel, and mhughes at northstarfixtures dot com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I’m adding those now. The prorated amount for the rest of the term is $1,146.75 before tax, and it’ll show on invoice 77138.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. Use PO 450092 if you need one.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect, I added the PO. The three invites are queued, and they should get them within about five minutes. If they don’t, have them check spam first, then reply to the ticket.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. That’s all I needed. Thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. I’ll send the confirmation email now. Have a good one.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, they’re off. I’m retyping the seat change into the ticketing system, copying the PO and invoice notes into the billing tool, and finishing the internal change form.
